subject: URGENT: CartFlow production errors & latency spike — client streaming header edge-case
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@cartflow.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: ops@cartflow.com
Date: 2028-10-14T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: [URGENT] 502 / high latency spikes since 08:00 PDT

Priyom —

We started seeing a spike in 5xx responses and tail latency from your hosted endpoint (~08:00 PDT). Errors are concentrated on our live checkout flow when we stream cart-entropy to your API. The error rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~7% and p95 latency went from 180ms to ~1.6s. We rolled back our SDK to the previous release (which disabled HTTP/2 trailers) and errors dropped immediately.

Attached is a short HAR and a couple of server logs. Can you triage? Our CSAT is at risk; leadership is asking for a quick explanation and mitigation.

Attachments: server-logs-20281014.tar.gz, screenshot-502.png

— Oliver
Head of Platform, CartFlow
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2028-10-14T08:31:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: [URGENT] 502 / high latency spikes since 08:00 PDT

Forwarding CartFlow incident — their live checkout streaming shows big error + latency spike. Ops rolled back their SDK and observed immediate improvement. They attach logs and a HAR.

Monica / Rishi: can you prioritize a repro and confirm whether our gateway or the client parser is mis-handling HTTP/2 trailer frames / chunked headers? CC-ing Hannah for customer comms.

Priority: P0 for the next 3 hours — CartFlow is on a paid Dedicated pilot and execs are watching.

— Priyom
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: priom_das@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2028-10-14T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: [URGENT] 502 / high latency spikes since 08:00 PDT

On Oct 14, 2028, Oliver reported a regression tied to HTTP/2 trailers. I pulled the logs (attached) and saw repeated parser exceptions flagged as "malformed header block" at the ingress layer, followed by upstream timeouts. Repro steps: we replayed their HAR against a staging gateway configured with our streaming parser and saw the same parse failure ~25% of requests.

Immediate mitigation options:
- Deploy a tolerant parser patch that treats trailing pseudo-headers as opaque metadata (fast, ~30m rollout to hosted lanes).
- Add a tactical fallback: if parse error detected, route to an alternative model variant with strict compatibility (adds ~100ms tail).

I recommend deploying the tolerant parser to hosted within the hour and enabling fallback for their tenant. I'll open a PR with tests and a canary plan.

Attachments: repro-client.zip, parser-stacktrace.log

— Rishi
Engineering (Runtime)
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@cartflow.com>, ops@cartflow.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-10-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: [URGENT] 502 / high latency spikes since 08:00 PDT

Hi Oliver —

Thanks for the quick signal and logs. We're seeing the same pattern in our telemetry: increased parse failure counts at the ingress, which then cascade to throttles and 502s. Rishi has a repro and is preparing a tolerant parser patch.

Immediate actions we will take:
- Patch staged parser to accept trailing headers as opaque (target: deploy to hosted canary within 40 minutes).
- Enable tenant-level fallback routing for CartFlow to an alternate model variant to reduce failed requests while patch rolls out.
- Red team will validate the patch against your HAR and a synthetic burst profile.

We'll keep you posted every 30 minutes until closure. Apologies for the disruption — we understand checkout impact is critical.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2028-10-14T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Exec note — CartFlow latency spike (heads-up)

Looping in leadership for visibility. Oliver says CartFlow is seeing ~7% error rate and checkout latency sensitive. Priyom, please keep me posted on: mitigation progress, customer impact (pct of traffic affected; revenue-sensitive routes), and rollback / credit ask likelihood.

We should prepare a short post-incident note for the buyer (one pager) and be ready to offer a service credit if rollback > 15 minutes of degraded checkout. Rishi — coordinate with SRE on canary and on-call bandwidth.

— Aditya
Chief Customer Officer
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@cartflow.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: ops@cartflow.com
Date: 2028-10-15T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: RE: [RESOLVED] 502 / high latency spikes — confirmation

Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. We observed the tolerant parser patch in hosted canary yesterday evening and then the tenant fallback during our morning peak; our error rate has stabilized back to ~0.3% and p95 latency is ~200ms. The CartFlow SREs validated the fix against our production-like traffic and couldn't reproduce the issue.

A couple of follow-ups:
- Can you share the post-incident summary and the ETA for a permanent fix in the Dedicated runtime?
- We'll ask legal to open a support credit conversation — I'll send the formal request.

Appreciate the rapid response and the clear comms.

— Oliver
Head of Platform, CartFlow
